website_summary.name: Wild Animal Detection Hub
website_summary.description: The website features a clean and organized layout with a misty rose background and firebrick UI elements, designed for monitoring and alerting users about wild animal sightings.
website_summary.appearance: The website has a minimalist design with a misty rose background and firebrick accents for UI elements. It is divided into two main sections: "Detected Animals" and "Animal Gallery." The "Detected Animals" section displays a placeholder message indicating no detections yet. The "Animal Gallery" section showcases various wild animals, each with a photo, a brief description, and an "Alert OFF" button. Each animal is color-coded with a small colored dot next to its name. The header includes the title "Wild Animal Detection" and a subtitle describing the system's purpose. The overall layout is responsive, with a grid structure for the animal profiles that adjusts based on screen size.
website_summary.functionality: The website allows users to browse profiles of different wild animals, each with a unique color code. Users can toggle SMS alerts for each animal by clicking the "Alert OFF" button. The system is designed to detect animals in real-time and notify users via SMS when a specific animal is spotted. Users can also clear recent observations from the "Detected Animals" section. The website is built with Next.js and includes interactive elements like buttons and hover effects for a better user experience.

functionality_testing.name: Toggle Alert Status Button
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that the Alert OFF button successfully toggles the alert status.

Verify that the alert status changes to 'ON' and the button displays 'Alert ON'.
